title: fix(security)!: app-automation elevation does not change or delete an append-only object's rows
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing: a system flow's, a system hook body's and an action body's update or delete of a managedBy 'append-only' object, and their delete of a record such a ledger row references, are refused at run time)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:以系统身份运行的应用自动化(`runAs: 'system'` 的流程、以系统身份运行的沙箱钩子体、动作脚本体及动作的引擎门面)不能再修改或删除 `managedBy: 'append-only'` 对象(审计日志、动态流及同类账本)的记录,也不能删除被账本行引用的记录(删除会改动该账本行),返回 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`。本检查只判 update/transfer/delete/purge/restore,不判 insert。
- 为什么改:账本记录"发生过什么",只应由拥有它的平台服务写入;按维护者裁决(#32004 上的裁决记录 6787890900),应用自动化的提权不越过这条线。
- 风险与回滚:应用若用系统流程/钩子/动作改写或删除账本行,或删除被账本行引用的记录(最常见是用户),会从成功变为失败;本仓与 HotCRM 普查未发现此类写法。平台自身写入者(保留期清理、迁移、审计封存等)不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/flow-system-identity-write-refusal.ts`(新增的判断函数,复用身份写入拒绝的同一谓词)、`security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`(调用点,位于系统短路之前)、`packages/services/service-automation/src/runas-system-append-only-write-refusal.integration.test.ts`(真实流程的端到端钉子与对照)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/runas-system-append-only-write-refusal.integration.test.ts`,预期 8 个用例全部通过(4 个直接拒绝 + 2 个引用清理拒绝及平台对照 + 2 个对照)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The rule: **app-authored automation's system elevation does not change or delete the rows of an append-only object.**

- `plugin-security` `flow-system-identity-write-refusal.ts`: `assertAppAutomationAppendOnlyWriteAllowed` refuses an `update`, `transfer`, `delete`, `purge` or `restore` of an object whose registered schema declares `managedBy: 'append-only'`, from a context the identity-assignment refusal's predicate names (`elevationSource`: `isSystem` AND (`flowRunId` OR the app-automation mark)). No second predicate. The bucket is read off the live registry, and only once the context is such an elevation.
- `security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`: the check sits beside the identity refusal, ahead of the `isSystem` short-circuit.
- This check covers the update, transfer, delete, purge and restore of an append-only object; an insert is not judged by it. Every answer says so.
- A delete of a record that a ledger row references is refused whole: the engine's clean-up of that reference on the ledger row is a change to an append-only object made under the automation's context (seat decision on the contract review). Nothing is deleted and the ledger row does not move. That refusal names the delete and says that deleting this record would change a record in an append-only ledger that references it, and its remedy is to keep and retire the record.
- The answer is the identity refusal's: `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403, with a message naming the operation, the object, the source and the rule. No new error code.
- `spec`: the flow `runAs`, hook `runAs` and action `body` descriptions state the rule, its verbs and that an insert is not judged; the reference pages are regenerated from them.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`: row 25 states the rule and cites the predicate it shares (the generated register now keys `elevationSource` to rows 1b and 25); row 1b names its sibling check.

Unchanged: reads of append-only objects from the same automation; its writes to every other object except a delete of a record a ledger row references, and the audit and activity rows the platform records for them; the platform's own writers, whose system context carries neither a flow run nor the mark, including a platform delete of a record a ledger row references.

## Tests

Test names state the rule.

- `plugin-security` `flow-system-identity-write-refusal.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe`: the predicate over every judged verb, from a flow (user-triggered and user-less), a hook and an action elevation, on two append-only objects; the bucket read off the schema and never the name; a platform writer, a de-elevated run or mark, reads and other objects pass, and no schema is asked for a context that is not judged; through the real middleware on a real engine, update and delete refused with the store unmoved; the reference clean-up leg: its answer names the delete, the referencing ledger and the rule, and no id, and a flow, hook or action elevation's delete of a user a ledger row references is refused 403 with the user and the ledger row unmoved; CONTROL, a platform delete of the same user lands and clears the reference; a platform writer updates and deletes both ledgers, and the same elevations still read them and write an ordinary object.
- `runtime` `app-automation-identity-write-refusal.integration.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe`: a sandboxed hook body that runs as system, and an action body through `ctx.api` and through the action's engine facade: update and delete on two append-only objects refused, row unmoved. CONTROL: the same body reads both ledgers and updates and deletes an ordinary object; a hook registered in code writes a ledger row; a platform writer updates and deletes both ledgers.
- `service-automation` `runas-system-append-only-write-refusal.integration.test.ts` (new): a real `runAs: 'system'` flow's `update_record` and `delete_record` on the real `sys_audit_log` and `sys_activity` (AuditPlugin), user-triggered and user-less, on rows of two organizations: refused, rows unmoved. The same flow's `delete_record` of a user a `sys_activity` or a `sys_audit_log` row references: refused `PERMISSION_DENIED` with the clean-up wording, user and ledger row unmoved, and a platform delete of the same user lands and clears the reference. CONTROL: a platform system context updates and deletes both; the same flow reads both and creates an ordinary record, and the audit writer records that create in both ledgers.

## Acceptance notes

- A publish-time lint for this rule is not in this PR: the platform's append-only objects are not visible to `@objectstack/lint`, which reads the stack and `@objectstack/spec` only. Where that set should come from is with the seat.
- The insert half of the ruling and the publish-time lint are decided by the seat separately.
